content_of_post_to_comment:
I am a 25 year old woman. According to others, I am smart, intelligent, confident, bold and beautiful. Trust me I don't think any of those things is true. I suffer with confidence a lot. If there is anyone that can doubt my ability it is me. I am also the least consistent in doing things.

I just want to start exercising and get in a better shape, I am not saying I am fat and need to lose weight. Thank the universe, I am normal size for now but I really want to stay fit and workout everyday for my own health. I can't seem to follow that.

I also don't have any goals. No career goals, no financial goals, no personal goals. Part of it is maybe because I am kind of comfortable right now but however, I like myself having some goals and working towards them. I tried to write down all the things I really want in life. All of them came back to only one thing, having enough money to live a more than comfortable life. I want to travel, buy things so on and so forth. But it's not clear. It's very confusing to even say it in words here.

Will I ever get clarity about what I really want and will I achieve that at some point?

I hope so.
